mapper.select: select r.id, r.reporter_id, r.target_id, r.report_reason as reason, r.report_content as reportContent, r.created_time, c.content as targetContent, c.target_type as source, COALESCE( case when c.target_type = 1 then m.music_name when c.target_type = 2 then p.playlist_name when c.target_type = 3 then a.album_name when c.target_type = 4 then cp.title when c.target_type = 5 then mv.mv_name else '未知内容' end, '未知内容' ) as title, r.handle_status as status, uc.id as authorId, uc.username as authorName, uc.avatar as authorAvatar, ur.username as reporterName, ur.avatar as reporterAvatar from user_report as r inner join comment as c on r.target_id = c.id left join music as m on c.target_type = 1 and c.target_id = m.id left join playlist as p on c.target_type = 2 and c.target_id = p.id left join album as a on c.target_type = 3 and c.target_id = a.id left join community_post as cp on c.target_type = 4 and c.target_id = cp.id left join music_mv as mv on c.target_type = 5 and c.target_id = mv.id left join user as uc on c.user_id = uc.id left join user as ur on r.reporter_id = ur.id where r.id = #{reportId} order by r.created_time desc
